entrance: Entrance marker identified. The first junction is ahead.
choice: First junction. Left and right branches are available. Choose a branch.
left: Left branch selected. The planned direction is left.

turn: Second junction identified. The planned route turns right here.
destination: Destination marker identified. Confirm arrival to finish.
